//: One source of truth for the per-plugin CI lanes. Read by integrations/tooling/lanes.mjs, which .github/workflows/ci.yml and integrations/tooling/run-lane.mjs both go through. See integrations/PARALLEL_LANES.md.
sharedIndexNote: Port block for the CI jobs that are not a plugin lane — the hosting-surface check and the generic plugin-system e2e suite. A reserved index rather than a separate fixed block, so there is one port formula and lanes.test.mjs can prove it collides with nothing. No lane may take index 9.

lanes.note: paths: devonian/github-issues/ imports the devonian package from source (vitest.config.ts aliases it to devonian/src/main.ts), so a devonian change runs this lane too. Its tests ran in devonian CI before the lens moved here.

No lane job, on purpose. money has an atomicCertification block, so the unsharded certification step in shared-checks already runs exactly its typecheck (tsconfig.json) and unit (vitest.config.ts) on every integrations/** change, plus bundle reproducibility; typecheck/unit tiers here would only repeat that. Add a tier once money has a server-dependent test. moneybird is listed but not consumed: integrations/money/ is an MT940/camt.053 uploader with no Moneybird code, and the moneybird catalog entry has no package in this repo. With no tier, no mock proxy is started for this lane. A future Moneybird fixture and its recorder go in integrations/money/fixtures/moneybird/ (plugin-specific files stay in the plugin folder); integrations/localthought/fixtures/index.mjs registers it by importing ../../money/fixtures/moneybird/scenario.mjs. See PARALLEL_LANES.md, Still open.

lanes.quarantined: e2e: the spec now drives the Notion drive plugin (integrations/notion/app/) through the host's integration-proxy relay (store.proxy, its consent bar and connect return), which #52 adds to atomic-server and the pinned commit does not have. Once .atomic-server-ref contains it: set platforms to ["notion"] (the spec uses the shared mock proxy's notion fixture) and add "e2e" to tiers. See #68 and integrations/notion/README.md.
lanes.note: platforms is empty while e2e is quarantined: the live tier stubs fetch in-process and never talks to the lane's mock proxy. The e2e spec needs the mock with the authored integrations/notion/fixtures/notion/ fixture.

e2e drives the Pets drive app (integrations/pets/app/) in its plugin iframe: connect through the host's consent bar and the mock proxy, then import through the host proxy relay (#52). It needs an .atomic-server-ref that includes the relay (atomic-server claude/plugin-proxy-relay, #1624); against an older pin the app reports that the host cannot reach the proxy and the spec fails at 'Not connected'.

No e2e tier. The upstream Clockify tests (plugins.spec.ts's pair and clockify-import.spec.ts) were deleted in atomic-server 4bab16ee6, which the pin includes, together with the UI they drove, so there was nothing to move (#44). A new e2e tier needs a new entry point, most likely #20's timesheets drive app once atomic-server#1624 and an install flow exist.
